_README: Seeded once by the AI-Handbook sync, then owned by this repository. EDIT BOTH FIELDS BEFORE USE. Left as-is, the machinery refuses rather than guesses: the placeholder below is rejected by name and every review request blocks with a message naming this file. That is the intended failure -- it announces itself instead of silently protecting nothing.
_repo: This repository's GitHub owner/name, exactly as the API spells it. Read only when a review budget is declared, where it is stamped into the budget receipt. A wrong value can only strand a loop -- the stamped repository is compared against the repository each outgoing review request names, so a budget declared under the wrong identity authorizes nothing anywhere.
_requiredChecks: The CI jobs that must be PRESENT before a readiness receipt is honest -- every job that can appear late, not only the ones that must pass. A job gated on an earlier one is created late, so a snapshot taken too early sees a complete green set without it. Use the jobs.*.name values from this repo's workflows. Read from the branch a pull request merges into, never from the pull request itself.
